meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "Terms & Conditions" opens the "Edit Terms & Conditions" window
gaps: Prove comprehensively that no event data changes until Upload, Cancel, or Done is pressed
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Prove comprehensively that no event data changes until Upload, Cancel, or Done is pressed

steps.note: Start an eRFX draft creation flow.
Apply a template so the draft has a configured stage.
Add a line item to make the draft representative and expose the Terms & Conditions control.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft required by the case.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Open the terms editor without submitting any changes.
Verify that the expected terms editing window opened.
Verify the window provides an Upload action.
Verify the window provides a Cancel action.
Verify the window provides a Done action.
